Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1267250. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay CHEMBL1267250 and keep only rows where standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation IS NOT NULL, and standard_relation = '='. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
